detail.longDescription: ZimaBoard NVMe RAID1 with Btrfs for Docker Volumes This snippet configures a software RAID1 array across two NVMe drives on the ZimaBoard, formatted with Btrfs, and mounts it at /mnt/raid1. The command uses mdadm to create the array, then mkfs.btrfs t # DevOps # Linux # ValtersIT https://www. valtersit.com/vault/zimaboard- nvme-raid1-with-btrfs-for-docker-volumes-1c4d60/
